name: rosetta-stone-tax-decree
description: A priestly decree carved in three scripts praised a young Egyptian king for cutting temple taxes and pardoning debts.

name: han-dynasty-census
description: Imperial officials recorded households and individuals across China, the earliest census whose figures survive.

name: quirinius-census-judea
description: A Roman governor counted the people and property of a newly annexed province for taxation, as the Gospel story recalls.

name: danegeld-first-paid
description: After a defeat by Viking raiders, an English king handed over silver to buy peace, then taxed his people to raise it.

name: saladin-tithe-levied
description: A levy of a tenth of income and movable goods was ordered across Western Europe to fund a crusade to retake Jerusalem.

name: ship-money-levied
description: A king ruling without Parliament revived a coastal naval levy and extended it inland, stoking fierce resentment.

name: window-tax-england
description: Householders were taxed by the number of windows in their homes, and many bricked them up to avoid paying.

name: peter-great-beard-tax
description: A Russian tsar set out to Westernise his nobles by charging them a fee to keep their traditional facial hair.

name: corn-laws-enacted
description: Britain barred cheap imported grain until home prices rose, protecting landowners while keeping bread dear for the poor.

name: peel-revives-income-tax
description: A Conservative prime minister brought back a tax on incomes in peacetime to offset cuts to tariffs, and it never left.

name: us-first-federal-income-tax
friendly_name: US Levies First Federal Income Tax
description: To fund a civil war, Congress taxed incomes for the first time, later letting the measure lapse.

name: peoples-budget-lloyd-george
description: A British chancellor proposed taxing land and high incomes to pay for pensions and warships, provoking a clash with the Lords.

name: pay-as-you-go-withholding
description: American employers started deducting income tax straight from wages, so that millions of workers paid as they earned.

name: france-introduces-vat
description: A tax collected at each stage of production, charged only on the value added, was pioneered and later spread worldwide.

name: california-proposition-13
description: Voters capped property tax rates and required a supermajority to raise taxes, sparking a nationwide tax revolt.

name: scotland-poll-tax
description: A flat per-person local levy replaced property rates a year before England, provoking mass non-payment and later riots.

name: nafta-takes-effect
description: The US, Canada and Mexico began phasing out tariffs on most goods traded between them, creating a vast free trade zone.

name: china-abolishes-agricultural-tax
description: After many centuries, farmers in the world's most populous country stopped paying a tax on their harvests.

name: global-minimum-corporate-tax-deal
description: More than 130 countries backed a deal setting a floor on corporate tax rates to curb profit shifting to havens.
